Flavor sweet, non-toxic. It mainly treats wind bi [風痹] and wasting-thirst [消渴], boosts kidney qi, strengthens yin, supplements insufficiency, and removes evil damp. Taken over a long time, the face becomes lustrous and one is without

Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: Alisma [澤瀉], flavor sweet, cold.
